name: HexaTrainer
summary:
Hexatrainer is an educational and trainer platform for limb deformity correction procedures using external circular fixation systems. It provides virtual and mixed reality workshops and a special workshop where you can visualize anatomy and practice pinning through safe corridors. 

Features:
- Complete hexapod system (Full and rings, foot plates, bolts, blocks, posts, etc...). 
- Lots of example cases. 
- Free assembly sequence (allows premounting). 
- Free positioning of components, osteotomy level and or
